decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core two-component coating know-how into harsh-environment protective coatings, so its investment and fit with the firm's direction favour keeping it despite only a brief website mention.

The injection pump has its own web page, sits close to the established construction-repair offer and was launched only recently, so the firm's visible commitment and sunk development effort argue strongly for persisting.
The transfer pump builds on in-house pump engineering and is too new to be judged, so any weak early results can be read as temporary and management would keep it in the range.
The flow monitoring product has its own web page and supports the announced push toward digitalized, monitored production, so it is central to the firm's stated direction and worth defending.
